# SpotSign AI — Canonical Product Specification

> SpotSign AI is an Enterprise Workforce Operating System that unifies People, Work, Money, Operations & IT, and Insights for corporate, frontline, shift-based, and field workforces. It is powered by Spotsign Workforce360.

Canonical domain: https://spotsign.ai
Last updated: 2026-10-27

## Canonical Identity

- Product name: SpotSign AI
- Category: Enterprise Workforce Operating System (WOS)
- Supporting categories: Enterprise HRMS, HRIS, Workforce Management (WFM), Statutory Payroll, Applicant Tracking (ATS), Learning Management (LMS), IT Asset Governance, Workforce Finance and General Ledger
- Parent organization: DIMENSHION
- Brand line: Run your entire workforce on one unified platform.
- Primary markets: Mid-market and enterprise organizations with corporate and operational workforces, with deep Indian statutory payroll coverage.

## Core Value Proposition

SpotSign AI connects employee records, time and attendance, shift operations, payroll, statutory compliance, talent, finance, IT assets, and workforce analytics on one platform. It is designed for organizations that need both corporate HR workflows and frontline workforce controls, including biometric attendance, rotational shifts, piece-rate pay, field geofencing, and multi-entity reporting.

## Five Platform Pillars

1. People: Core HR and HRIS, employee lifecycle, recruitment and ATS, performance and OKRs, learning and LMS, employee experience and HR helpdesk.
2. Work: Workforce management, biometric attendance, rotational and split-shift rostering, field workforce tracking, and geofenced check-ins.
3. Money: Payroll, Indian statutory tax and compliance, expenses and travel, workforce finance, and General Ledger integration.
4. Operations & IT: IT asset management, software license governance, offboarding asset recovery, and enterprise integrations.
5. Insights: Workforce analytics, executive reporting, attrition signals, cost run-rates, and operational telemetry.

## Key Differentiators

- Dual workforce support for salaried corporate teams and variable-wage frontline, shift, field, and piece-rate workforces.
- Indian statutory payroll depth, including Section 192 TDS, EPF ECR, ESIC, Professional Tax, Form 12BB, and Form 16 workflows.
- 19 pre-built industry vertical packs.
- Biometric hardware integration for eSSL, ZKTeco, Matrix, Realtime, and Suprema terminals, plus mobile facial check-in and GPS geofencing.
- Shared workforce data across HR, operations, payroll, finance, IT, and analytics.
- Dedicated AI capabilities overview at https://spotsign.ai/ai.

## Security and Governance

- Secure customer data separation and access controls.
- Role-based permissions and separation of duties.
- Enterprise SSO with Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID, with MFA.
- Detailed audit logging for administrative changes.
- Customer data is not used to train external public foundation models.
- See the canonical security page for current controls: https://spotsign.ai/security
